ambiguities.text: GLOAS_FORK_EPOCH is set to Epoch(18446744073709551615) (max uint64), marked as TBD - no actual activation epoch specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a placeholder and the actual epoch will be set before mainnet deployment. For modeling purposes, treat as a future epoch boundary.

ambiguities.text: The function prevents validator pubkeys from being converted to builders if they have prior valid validator deposit signatures - unclear what constitutes 'prior' in the context of pending deposits
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'prior' means any deposit with a valid validator signature that was processed or queued before the builder deposit. This prevents existing validators from being hijacked into builder roles.

ambiguities.text: execution_payload_availability initialized with availability markers - the exact format and meaning of these markers is not detailed
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume availability markers are boolean or enum values tracking whether the execution payload was delivered for each recent slot. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: Builder deposits can be reliably distinguished from validator deposits via withdrawal credentials alone
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Misclassification could cause validators to be incorrectly onboarded as builders or vice versa, disrupting both consensus and block building

implicit_assumptions.description: The removal of latest_execution_payload_header and replacement with latest_execution_payload_bid does not break any downstream consumers during the fork transition
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Components relying on the full execution payload header would fail after the fork, potentially causing chain splits or client crashes

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot craft deposits that exploit the builder/validator classification logic to register unauthorized builders
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious builders could enter the registry and manipulate block building, potentially extracting MEV or censoring transactions
